from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.HITORI_SHARED_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.HITORI_SHARED_AGG,
        )
        draft = await shared(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.HITORI_DRAFT_FINAL, prompt_custom.HITORI_VERIFY_FINAL])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate analysis/solution:\n" + draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}

Problem:
{problem}

Shared document so far:
{document}

Agent {agent_id}, round {round}. Add concise, high-value analysis only:

- black cells are not orthogonally adjacent
- all white cells stay connected
- avoid unnecessary extra black cells

Candidate: [(r, c), ...]
or
